dropped.finding: The new CHANGELOG 0.16.0 entry misstates how plan-review reuse works. It says a current PASS is reused for an unchanged ticket 'whichever engine signed it' and that 'only a BLOCK is reused per engine'. That suggests an agentic review also reuses a current PASS and replays its own stored BLOCK. In the code, PASS reuse, BLOCK reuse and drift refresh run only when the requested engine is `pipeline`, and BLOCK reuse refuses any stored verdict that did not come from the pipeline engine. An agentic re-review always runs the agent again.
scenarios: A user reads the 0.16.0 entry, runs `rebar review-plan --engine agentic` again on an unchanged ticket, and expects the earlier PASS or BLOCK to be reused at no model cost. The agent runs again and is billed.
dropped.suggested_fix: Replace the last sentence of the CHANGELOG.md:27-32 bullet with: "Reuse and drift refresh happen only for `pipeline` requests. A `pipeline` review of an unchanged ticket returns a current PASS whichever engine signed it, so it can return an agentic PASS without running, and only a pipeline BLOCK is replayed. An `agentic` review always runs the agent again."
